title: Fakes
description: The fake handlers' files (SPEC §5.4, §6.2), after YAML parsing. Keys are the question or command text after interpolation, or `line:N` for the statement on line N of SKILL.md. Each fake scenario directory also holds `expected-exit`: the exit code the run must end with (PLAN.md §3).

answers.description: answers.yaml: a probs object keyed by option id (with optional `unassigned`), or `unsure`, `unavailable` or `invalid` to force that path.

commands.description: commands.yaml: how each command ends. An unmatched command is E-FAKE-UNMATCHED; no real command ever runs.
